notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

notes.title: A Special Offer as a Thank You for Buying Last Inua
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/41cdaf55dc82d564e18a1c511021e298ea6e790d.png[/img]

Thank you for buying Last Inua and being part of the Wired Family.

Wired Productions both as players, and publishers - adore lovingly crafted narrative stories created by some of the most talented storytellers in the industry.

Because we value you as a fan, we are offering you a special deal on our newly released game - KARMA : The Dark World.

This offer has been created specifically for owners of Last Inua, giving you the opportunity to save up to $6 on KARMA (which combined with the 10% launch discount, gives you a saving of 25% off the original price)

Thank you for being a valued Wired family member, an aficionado of the kind of stories that are best experienced through the medium of gaming - and someone who's support enables indie developers to tell those stories across the world.

Simply click the link below to go to the Last Inua Wired Loyalty Bundle. This is a 'complete the set' bundle, meaning when you purchase, you only pay for KARMA, at £17.99/$22.49 - with the 15% loyalty discount applied to the price of the bundle.

(Please note the 10% launch discount ends on April 10th)

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51877/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Wired_Loyalty_Bundle/

[h3]ABOUT KARMA[/h3]

KARMA has become Wired's biggest day 1 launch EVER - and after 5 days with a Metacritic rating approaching 80, and over 1,000 reviews trending very positive on Steam to back it up.

If you loved the emotional exploration of Last Inua, you will instantly become gripped by Karma: The Dark World. Discover the secrets of 1984 East Germany, where nothing is as it truly seems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/85838382196d0a8acecb77f2a68635fad0cbc89d.png[/img]

Brought to you by the brilliant minds at Pollard Studio, KARMA isn’t just another spooky game. This is psychological horror dialled up to eleven, blending brain-melting mystery with stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a story that refuses to let go. It’s out now on PC and PlayStation 5, with a Deluxe Edition packed full of eerie extras – an exclusive soundtrack, a digital EP, and a gorgeous digital artbook for those who want to dive even deeper.

[previewyoutube=hNH-gh7FVMM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you once again for supporting indie games and being part of the Wired family. We hope you enjoy KARMA - and if you do end up playing it, please don't forget to leave a Steam review on the store page.

Much love - Wiredp

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

[b]Key features of the demo include: [/b] 

[list] 

[*] Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  
[*] Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  
[*] Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 
[*] Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

[/list] 

[b]FAQ [/b] 

We also have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602000/discussions/0/596267508946698487/]frequently asked questions[/url] post in the discussion area on steam so you can get help if needed. This will be a work in progress, but please check there before posting as it’ll help manage the flow of questions incoming during the demo!   

[b]Content Creators playing Hotel Architect [/b] 

We also have a fantastic bunch of creators going live today and throughout Steam Next Fest, if you want to absorb more Hotel architect when you can't play yourself. Perhaps while working or travelling etc! Check out this list below:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/81fc235bcd2e99b627ed0c073d8b0a26713c6190.jpg[/img]  

Well Good Luck & get building!  

We can't for you to try it out, and let us know what you think!  

P.S. If you haven't already, there is also a giveaway happening for playing the demo! head to [url=Wired.gg/HAgiveaway]Wired.gg/HAgiveaway[/url] to be in with the chance of winning some epic Razer Tech worth of $350 and Hotel Architect goodies!

notes.title: Unlocking the Mystery: Our Top-Secret Project Revealed!
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, gamers and thrill-seekers, gather 'round! The moment you’ve all been waiting for is finally here. After two years of clandestine development, late-night coding sessions, and more coffee than any sane person should consume, we’re ready to pull back the curtain on our latest creation. Buckle up, because this is going to be one wild ride!

We are delighted to reveal we are working with celebrated indie developers Just Add Water. 

Now, we know you’ve been wondering, “What’s this secret project all about?” Well, we’ve been as tight-lipped as a vault, but the wait is almost over. The game is like a locked treasure chest buried deep in the digital sands. The key? Your curiosity! 🔑

Wired Direct '24: The Grand Reveal:

Mark your calendars, set your alarms, and prepare to have your minds blown. On April 23rd, precisely at:
[list][*] 12:00 PST
[*] 15:00 EDT
[*] 20:00 BST[/list]We’ll be revealing more at Wired Direct '24, streaming straight to your screens. 

Where to Watch:
Head over to wired.gg/WiredDirect to witness the magic unfold. Trust us; you won’t want to miss this. More links!

The Countdown Begins:
In the meantime, grab your favourite snacks, put on your lucky gaming socks, and join us as we embark on a brand-new adventure

Disclaimer: No actual secrets were harmed during the making of this blog post. But our excitement levels? Off the charts! 😜

Are you a diabetic or know any who suffers from that disease among your family and friends? Did you know that 1 diabetes (T1D) is an autoimmune disease that impacts more than 8M people worldwide? It's a terminal disease, but scientists and non-profit organisations are researching a cure.

notes.title: Arcade Paradise EP Launches for Safe In Our World
notes.content:
Every penny from your purchase goes straight to [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World.[/url]💰

[url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases][h2]GO BUY IT NOW![/h2][/url]

The song is the lead track from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388870/Arcade_Paradise/]Arcade Paradise[/url]. A Game where the protagonist Ashley feels held back, suffocated, and mentally downtrodden. Arcade Paradise is a story that resonates closely with the message of [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World[/url]. It is an inspirational message of what can be achieved, with help or just with the right motivation… how you CAN rise up against the machine, and how you CAN make your life great.

This is where you come in. We need YOU, the Wired Community to make some noise, Kick down the doors and scream that talking about Mental Health is GOOD!

How can YOU do this? There are lots of ways:

- Buy the single on [url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases ]Bandcamp[/url]. (Same price as a meal deal)
- Stream the song for the next week. Let's see if we can hit the charts. Bring on Top of the Pops.
- Share posts, blogs and playlists. The more we share. The more we can diminish the stigma around Mental Health
- Talk to someone and listen. a Simple "How's it going?" can make the world of difference.
- Make sure to tag us in every post, tweet and video. The more we share, the better.

Watch the Official Music Video below

[previewyoutube=GVfC5C5FopU;full][/previewyoutube]

All proceeds from sales of the Arcade Paradise EP from Bandcamp will be donated to the video games mental health charity Safe In Our World, but why did we choose them? Watch below to find out:
